Title: Remove is unavailable when product is NotInCart (Negative | High)

▶ Start URL:    https://www.saucedemo.com/product-detail.html
▶ Requires Auth: Yes
▶ Test Data:
{
  "username": "standard_user",
  "password": "secret_sauce",
  "observed_product_state": "InCart"
}

Preconditions:
  User is on the Product Detail page for the product. NOTE: verification snapshot shows the product is InCart (Remove button present) — precondition adjusted to reflect observed state.

Steps to Execute:
  1. Open the Product Detail page for a product whose state is NotInCart
  2. Look for a Remove button on the page
  3. If visible, attempt to click it

Expected Result:
  The Remove button is not visible or is disabled; the page shows the Add to cart action instead; product remains NotInCart and no item is removed.

Notes from prior verification:
  The verification snapshot showed a precondition mismatch: the Remove button was present despite the test's NotInCart precondition. Preconditions were updated to reflect the observed InCart state. The test as originally written (expecting Remove to be unavailable) will not hold in this environment.
